text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the Takarazuka Kinen, cheers 
roar across the paddock. Yet they seemed 
directed not at the runners, but at the 
historic race itself.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
One day, I will make the crowd cheer like 
this on my own. Filled with renewed 
determination, Zenno Rob Roy takes on the 
race.
